name: Hollow Rock
instructions: Start in a solid hollow hold — lower back pressed down, shoulders and legs lifted.
Initiate a gentle rocking motion from the shoulders, not by kicking the legs.
Rock forward and back smoothly, maintaining the hollow shape throughout.
Keep the rhythm controlled and continue 15-30 seconds.
longevityNotes: A stable trunk protects the spine through every decade. Train the core for endurance and control rather than chasing burn.
overview: An intermediate just your bodyweight core exercise for the abs. Hollow Rock builds the trunk stability that underpins safe movement as you age.
